summary: Agent-native software development platform whose Droid agent runs in CLI, web, chat, issue trackers and mobile.
description: An agent-native development platform built around its coding agent Droid, with sessions across CLI, desktop, web, Slack/Teams, Linear/Jira and mobile. TypeScript and Python SDKs, a GitHub Action that runs code reviews and PR descriptions, a plugins marketplace and an ESLint plugin extend it. Plans run from $20/month up to custom enterprise deployments.
